$comment: DNA OS — MCP discovery for external contractors (NEW-2, 2026-09-23; discovery target repaired BATCH 13). Freebuff loads this file (and .agents/) from the working directory when run with --trust-agents; Cline is registered separately in its own cline_mcp_settings.json. This file POINTS at the real DNA OS MCP server: connections/dna-os-mcp/server.ts over its stdio transport (same server that serves the canonical Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8793 — stdio spawn never binds a port, so it cannot collide with the running instance). It holds no credential: DNA_OS_API_TOKEN must be exported by whoever launches Freebuff for claim/submit tools (a token value must never be committed here).

dna-os.description: DNA OS central coordinator (stdio transport of the canonical dna-os-mcp server; its HTTP peer lives at 127.0.0.1:8793/mcp). Contractors PULL work through contractor.task.claim, report back through contractor.evidence.submit, and read status through contractor.status. Read-only tools are safe to auto-run; claim/submit require the DNA OS API token and Owner approval per the Worker Contract.
